specialists.description: Plans and builds rendering: forward, deferred or forward+ pipelines, pass budgets, API choice incl. WebGPU, shader ports across languages. Use for render architecture, GPU cost, shaders.

specialists.name: performance-engineer
specialists.description: Reads profiler captures, names the bound (CPU, GPU, memory, IO) with numbers, and sets frame budgets. Use for stutter, low FPS, hitches, memory growth, perf regressions.

specialists.name: physics-programmer
specialists.description: Builds and diagnoses game physics, collision detection, character contacts and simulation stability. Use for tunneling, jitter, fixed steps and collision filtering.

specialists.name: save-systems-engineer
specialists.description: Designs versioned, corruption-safe save formats with migrations, atomic writes and cloud sync rules. Use for save schemas, slots, Steam Cloud, save migration tests, corrupted saves.

specialists.name: technical-artist
specialists.description: Bridges art and code: asset pipeline specs, texture packing, LODs, import presets and shader cost reviews. Use for naming rules, texel density, texture compression, shader variants, overdraw.

specialists.name: technical-director
specialists.description: Owns technical direction: engine, language and backend choices as ADRs, risk register, cross-system contracts, budgets. Use for stack decisions, architecture reviews, technical risk.

specialists.name: tools-programmer
specialists.description: Scopes and builds in-editor tools for Unity, Godot, Unreal and web editors, with undo, validation and docs. Use for custom inspectors, editor windows, batch tools, content validators.

specialists.name: ui-programmer
specialists.description: Implements game HUDs and menus with input navigation, layout, state and accessibility. Use for controller focus, responsive UI, menu bugs and UI integration.
